verdict.rationale: Cognee's recall() operation classifies natural-language queries and auto-picks a retrieval strategy, the CLI lets users 'ask questions' from the terminal, and the MCP server exposes memory operations to AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline) that interact via natural language. This supports operating Cognee with natural-language commands, but there's no dedicated chat/command-language spec or example showing flexible free-form command handling beyond query classification. Missing for 10: explicit examples of natural-language command syntax beyond search queries, hands-on/independent confirmation of NL command robustness, and documentation of a broader NL command surface (e.g. for remember/improve/forget via plain English).
